from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs/task-f779225a.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # A full, non-background row or column separates two equal-sized panels.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0 and r * 2 + 1 == h:
            a, b = grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]
            return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ar, br)] for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
    for c in range(w):
        if all(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(h)) and len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and c * 2 + 1 == w:
            left = [row[:c] for row in grid]
            right = [row[c + 1:] for row in grid]
            return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(lr, rr)] for lr, rr in zip(left, right)]
    # A separator may have unequal panel widths/heights; use equal-size extent around it.
    for r in range(h):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1 and grid[r][0] != 0:
            n = min(r, h-r-1)
            if n:
                a, b = grid[r-n:r], grid[r+1:r+1+n]
                return [[2 if x != 0 and y != 0 else 0 for x, y in zip(ar, br)] for ar, br in zip(a, b)]
    for c in range(w):
        vals=[grid[r][c] for r in range(h)]
        if vals[0] != 0 and len(set(vals)) == 1:
            n=min(c,w-c-1)
            if n:
                return [[2 if grid[r][c-n+i] != 0 and grid[r][c+1+i] != 0 else 0 for i in range(n)] for r in range(h)]
    return [row[:] for row in grid]
'''
p.write_text(code)
grid=[[0,0,0,3,1,0,3,3,3],[0,3,3,0,1,0,3,3,0],[3,0,3,0,1,0,3,0,3],[3,3,0,0,1,0,3,3,3]]
print(transform(grid))
print(code)
